For every panel (block column) k:\n//   1. the NB x NB diagonal block is allgathered from its row owners and\n//      factored redundantly on every rank (cheap, and it replaces a broadcast),\n//   2. every rank solves its rows below the block: L_ik = A_ik * L_kk^-T,\n//   3. the panel L_{i>k,k} is allgathered with a nonblocking collective,\n//   4. every rank applies the rank-NB update A_ij -= L_ik * L_jk^T to its rows.\n// Lookahead: once panel k has arrived, the update is first applied to block\n// column k+1 only, panel k+1 is factored and its allgather is started, and the\n// remaining update of panel k overlaps with that communication.\n//\n// The floating-point operation order is independent of the number of ranks, so\n// the result is bitwise identical for any process count.\n\nnamespace {\n\nconstexpr size_t NB = 48;  // panel width\nconstexpr size_t DB = 8;   // row distribution block\nconstexpr size_t JW = 8;   // columns per packed panel tile\nconstexpr size_t JC = 48;  // tiles per L2 column chunk of the update\nstatic_assert(NB % DB == 0, \"panel width must be a multiple of the distribution block\");\nstatic_assert(DB % 4 == 0, \"distribution block must be a multiple of the row group size\");\nstatic_assert(DB == JW, \"distribution block must match the tile width\");\n\nstruct Dist {\n    size_t n = 0;\n    int rank = 0;\n    int nprocs = 1;\n    size_t nloc = 0;  // number of local rows\n\n    void init(size_t n_, int rank_, int nprocs_) {\n        n = n_;\n        rank = rank_;\n        nprocs = nprocs_;\n        nloc = localRows(rank);\n    }\n\n    // Global row index of local row li of rank r.\n    size_t globalRow(size_t li, int r) const {\n        return (li / DB * (size_t)nprocs + (size_t)r) * DB + li % DB;\n    }\n    size_t globalRow(size_t li) const { return globalRow(li, rank); }\n\n    // Number of rows of rank r with global index < g.\n    size_t localRowsBefore(size_t g, int r) const {\n        const size_t b = g / DB;  // block containing g\n        if (b < (size_t)r) return 0;\n        // complete blocks b' < b owned by r: b' = r, r + P, ..., < b\n        size_t cnt = (b > (size_t)r) ? ((b - 1 - (size_t)r) / (size_t)nprocs + 1) * DB : 0;\n        if ((b - (size_t)r) % (size_t)nprocs == 0) {\n            cnt += g - b * DB;  // leading part of block b, owned by r\n        }\n        return cnt;\n    }\n\n    size_t localRows(int r) const { return localRowsBefore(n, r); }\n};\n\n// Unblocked Cholesky of a dense nb x nb block (row stride nb) in place.\n// Returns the failing diagonal index or -1 on success.\nlong factorDiagonalBlock(double* blk, const size_t nb) {\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < nb; ++i) {\n        double* ri = blk + i * nb;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < i; ++j) {\n            const double* rj = blk + j * nb;\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                sum += ri[k] * rj[k];\n            }\n            ri[j] = (ri[j] - sum) / rj[j];\n        }\n        double sum = 0.0;\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < i; ++k) {\n            sum += ri[k] * ri[k];\n        }\n        const double val = ri[i] - sum;\n        if (val <= 0.0) {\n            return (long)i;\n        }\n        ri[i] = sqrt(val);\n    }\n    return -1;\n}\n\n// Triangular solve of R rows at once: row[r][c] for c < nb becomes L_i,(j0+c).\n// LkkT is the transposed diagonal block (LkkT[d * nb + c] = L_kk[c][d]).\ntemplate <int R>\ninline void trsmRows(double* const* rows, const double* __restrict LkkT, const size_t nb) {\n    for (size_t d = 0; d < nb; ++d) {\n        const double* ld = LkkT + d * nb;\n        const double ldd = ld[d];\n        for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) {\n            double* __restrict x = rows[r];\n            const double xd = x[d] / ldd;\n            x[d] = xd;\n            for (size_t c = d + 1; c < nb; ++c) {\n                x[c] -= xd * ld[c];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// --- Trailing update micro-kernel -------------------------------------------\n// The gathered panel is stored tile-packed: columns are grouped into tiles of\n// JW consecutive columns, and within a tile the nb panel entries of the JW\n// columns are interleaved: packed[(tile * nb + c) * JW + jj].\n\ntypedef double v4d __attribute__((vector_size(32)));\n\ninline v4d loadv(const double* p) {\n    v4d v;\n    memcpy(&v, p, sizeof(v));\n    return v;\n}\ninline void storev(double* p, v4d v) { memcpy(p, &v, sizeof(v)); }\ninline v4d bcastv(double x) { return v4d{x, x, x, x}; }\n\ninline void storeTile(double* ar, v4d acc0, v4d acc1, const size_t j, const size_t gend) {\n    if (j + JW <= gend + 1) {\n        storev(ar, loadv(ar) - acc0);\n        storev(ar + 4, loadv(ar + 4) - acc1);\n    } else {\n        double tmp[JW];\n        storev(tmp, acc0);\n        storev(tmp + 4, acc1);\n        const size_t len = (gend + 1 > j) ? gend + 1 - j : 0;\n        for (size_t jj = 0; jj < len; ++jj) {\n            ar[jj] -= tmp[jj];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// A[r][j] -= sum_c L[r][c] * P[c][j] for 4 rows and tiles [tb, te).\n// Row r only stores columns j <= gend[r]. jbase is the global column of tile 0.\ninline void updateTiles4(double* const* a, const double* const* l, const size_t* gend,\n                         const double* __restrict packed, const size_t nb, const size_t jbase,\n                         const size_t tb, const size_t te) {\n    const double* __restrict l0 = l[0];\n    const double* __restrict l1 = l[1];\n    const double* __restrict l2 = l[2];\n    const double* __restrict l3 = l[3];\n    for (size_t t = tb; t < te; ++t) {\n        const double* __restrict pk = packed + t * nb * JW;\n        v4d a00 = bcastv(0.0), a01 = a00, a10 = a00, a11 = a00;\n        v4d a20 = a00, a21 = a00, a30 = a00, a31 = a00;\n        for (size_t c = 0; c < nb; ++c) {\n            const v4d p0 = loadv(pk + c * JW);\n            const v4d p1 = loadv(pk + c * JW + 4);\n            v4d b;\n            b = bcastv(l0[c]); a00 += b * p0; a01 += b * p1;\n            b = bcastv(l1[c]); a10 += b * p0; a11 += b * p1;\n            b = bcastv(l2[c]); a20 += b * p0; a21 += b * p1;\n            b = bcastv(l3[c]); a30 += b * p0; a31 += b * p1;\n        }\n        const size_t j = jbase + t * JW;\n        storeTile(a[0] + j, a00, a01, j, gend[0]);\n        storeTile(a[1] + j, a10, a11, j, gend[1]);\n        storeTile(a[2] + j, a20, a21, j, gend[2]);\n        storeTile(a[3] + j, a30, a31, j, gend[3]);\n    }\n}\n\ninline void updateTiles1(double* a, const double* __restrict l0, const size_t gend,\n                         const double* __restrict packed, const size_t nb, const size_t jbase,\n                         const size_t tb, const size_t te) {\n    for (size_t t = tb; t < te; ++t) {\n        const double* __restrict pk = packed + t * nb * JW;\n        v4d a00 = bcastv(0.0), a01 = a00;\n        for (size_t c = 0; c < nb; ++c) {\n            const v4d b = bcastv(l0[c]);\n            a00 += b * loadv(pk + c * JW);\n            a01 += b * loadv(pk + c * JW + 4);\n        }\n        const size_t j = jbase + t * JW;\n        storeTile(a + j, a00, a01, j, gend);\n    }\n}\n\n// Trailing update of local rows [liStart, nloc) with the panel of columns\n// [j0, j0 + nb), restricted to global columns [cb, ce):\n//   A[i][j] -= L[i][k] . L[j][k]   for cb <= j < ce, j <= i.\n// packed holds the panel rows starting at global column jbase (= j0 + nb).\nvoid trailingUpdate(std::vector<double>& Aloc, const Dist& d, const double* packed,\n                    const size_t liStart, const size_t j0, const size_t nb, const size_t jbase,\n                    const size_t cb, const size_t ce) {\n    if (cb >= ce || liStart >= d.nloc) return;\n    const size_t n = d.n;\n    const size_t tBegin = (cb - jbase) / JW;\n    const size_t tEnd = (ce - jbase + JW - 1) / JW;\n    for (size_t tc = tBegin; tc < tEnd; tc += JC) {\n        const size_t tcEnd = std::min(tEnd, tc + JC);\n        size_t li = liStart;\n        // Row groups of 4 never straddle a distribution block (DB % 4 == 0 and\n        // liStart is a block boundary); only the last partial block has a remainder.\n        for (; li + 4 <= d.nloc; li += 4) {\n            double* a[4];\n            const double* l[4];\n            size_t g[4];\n            for (int r = 0; r < 4; ++r) {\n                a[r] = Aloc.data() + (li + r) * n;\n                l[r] = a[r] + j0;\n                g[r] = d.globalRow(li + r);\n            }\n            const size_t te = std::min(tcEnd, (g[3] + 1 - jbase + JW - 1) / JW);\n            if (tc < te) updateTiles4(a, l, g, packed, nb, jbase, tc, te);\n        }\n        for (; li < d.nloc; ++li) {\n            double* a = Aloc.data() + li * n;\n            const size_t g = d.globalRow(li);\n            const size_t te = std::min(tcEnd, (g + 1 - jbase + JW - 1) / JW);\n            if (tc < te) updateTiles1(a, a + j0, g, packed, nb, jbase, tc, te);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Per-panel state of the pipelined factorization.\nclass PanelFactorizer {\n  public:\n    PanelFactorizer(std::vector<double>& Aloc, const Dist& d)\n        : A_(Aloc), d_(d), n_(d.n), P_(d.nprocs) {\n        blockBuf_.resize(NB * NB);\n        blockRecv_.resize(NB * NB);\n        LkkT_.resize(NB * NB);\n        packed_.resize((n_ + JW) * NB);\n        sendbuf_.resize(d.nloc * NB);\n        recvbuf_.resize(n_ * NB);\n        counts_.resize(P_);\n        displs_.resize(P_);\n    }\n\n    // Factor the diagonal block of panel k (redundantly on every rank), solve\n    // the local rows below it and start the allgather of the panel.\n    // Returns false (on all ranks) if the matrix is not positive definite.\n    bool factorAndStart(const size_t k) {\n        const size_t j0 = k * NB;\n        const size_t nb = std::min(NB, n_ - j0);\n        const size_t j1 = j0 + nb;\n        curJ0_ = j0;\n        curNb_ = nb;\n        curJ1_ = j1;\n\n        // 1. allgather the diagonal block rows (columns [j0, j1)) from their owners\n        {\n            const size_t myFirst = d_.localRowsBefore(j0, d_.rank);\n            const size_t myCnt = d_.localRowsBefore(j1, d_.rank) - myFirst;\n            for (size_t q = 0; q < myCnt; ++q) {\n                memcpy(blockBuf_.data() + q * nb, A_.data() + (myFirst + q) * n_ + j0,\n                       nb * sizeof(double));\n            }\n            int disp = 0;\n            for (int r = 0; r < P_; ++r) {\n                const size_t cnt = d_.localRowsBefore(j1, r) - d_.localRowsBefore(j0, r);\n                counts_[r] = (int)(cnt * nb);\n                displs_[r] = disp;\n                disp += counts_[r];\n            }\n            MPI_Allgatherv(blockBuf_.data(), (int)(myCnt * nb), MPI_DOUBLE, blockRecv_.data(),\n                           counts_.data(), displs_.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n            for (int r = 0; r < P_; ++r) {\n                const size_t first = d_.localRowsBefore(j0, r);\n                const size_t cnt = (size_t)counts_[r] / nb;\n                for (size_t q = 0; q < cnt; ++q) {\n                    const size_t i = d_.globalRow(first + q, r) - j0;\n                    memcpy(blockBuf_.data() + i * nb, blockRecv_.data() + displs_[r] + q * nb,\n                           nb * sizeof(double));\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // 2. factor it (identical on every rank)\n        const long status = factorDiagonalBlock(blockBuf_.data(), nb);\n        if (status >= 0) {\n            if (d_.rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\",\n                       (size_t)(j0 + status));\n            }\n            return false;\n        }\n        {\n            // write back the owned rows of the factored block\n            const size_t myFirst = d_.localRowsBefore(j0, d_.rank);\n            const size_t myCnt = d_.localRowsBefore(j1, d_.rank) - myFirst;\n            for (size_t q = 0; q < myCnt; ++q) {\n                const size_t i = d_.globalRow(myFirst + q) - j0;\n                memcpy(A_.data() + (myFirst + q) * n_ + j0, blockBuf_.data() + i * nb,\n                       nb * sizeof(double));\n            }\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < nb; ++i) {\n                for (size_t c = 0; c < nb; ++c) {\n                    LkkT_[c * nb + i] = (c <= i) ? blockBuf_[i * nb + c] : 0.0;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        if (j1 >= n_) return true;  // last panel: nothing below the diagonal block\n\n        // 3. local TRSM for rows below the diagonal block\n        liStart_ = d_.localRowsBefore(j1, d_.rank);\n        {\n            size_t li = liStart_;\n            for (; li + 4 <= d_.nloc; li += 4) {\n                double* rows[4];\n                for (int r = 0; r < 4; ++r) rows[r] = A_.data() + (li + r) * n_ + j0;\n                trsmRows<4>(rows, LkkT_.data(), nb);\n            }\n            for (; li < d_.nloc; ++li) {\n                double* rows[1] = {A_.data() + li * n_ + j0};\n                trsmRows<1>(rows, LkkT_.data(), nb);\n            }\n        }\n\n        // 4. start the allgather of the panel (rows j1..n)\n        const size_t nrowsLoc = d_.nloc - liStart_;\n        for (size_t r = 0; r < nrowsLoc; ++r) {\n            memcpy(sendbuf_.data() + r * nb, A_.data() + (liStart_ + r) * n_ + j0,\n                   nb * sizeof(double));\n        }\n        int disp = 0;\n        for (int r = 0; r < P_; ++r) {\n            const size_t cnt = d_.localRows(r) - d_.localRowsBefore(j1, r);\n            counts_[r] = (int)(cnt * nb);\n            displs_[r] = disp;\n            disp += counts_[r];\n        }\n        MPI_Iallgatherv(sendbuf_.data(), (int)(nrowsLoc * nb), MPI_DOUBLE, recvbuf_.data(),\n                        counts_.data(), displs_.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &req_);\n        pending_ = true;\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    // Wait for the panel allgather and unpack it into the tile-packed layout.\n    void finishGather() {\n        if (!pending_) return;\n        MPI_Wait(&req_, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n        pending_ = false;\n        const size_t nb = curNb_;\n        const size_t j1 = curJ1_;\n        for (int r = 0; r < P_; ++r) {\n            const size_t first = d_.localRowsBefore(j1, r);\n            const size_t cnt = (size_t)counts_[r] / nb;\n            const double* src = recvbuf_.data() + displs_[r];\n            size_t q = 0;\n            // rows come in runs of DB (== JW) consecutive global rows aligned to\n            // tiles (j1 is a multiple of DB), so transpose JW rows at a time\n            for (; q + JW <= cnt; q += JW) {\n                const size_t g = d_.globalRow(first + q, r) - j1;\n                double* dst = packed_.data() + (g / JW) * nb * JW;\n                const double* s = src + q * nb;\n                for (size_t c = 0; c < nb; ++c) {\n                    for (size_t jj = 0; jj < JW; ++jj) {\n                        dst[c * JW + jj] = s[jj * nb + c];\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            for (; q < cnt; ++q) {\n                const size_t g = d_.globalRow(first + q, r) - j1;\n                double* dst = packed_.data() + (g / JW) * nb * JW + (g % JW);\n                const double* s = src + q * nb;\n                for (size_t c = 0; c < nb; ++c) {\n                    dst[c * JW] = s[c];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Apply the update of the current panel to columns [cb, ce) of local rows\n    // with global index >= rowFrom.\n    void update(const size_t rowFrom, const size_t cb, const size_t ce) {\n        const size_t liFrom = d_.localRowsBefore(rowFrom, d_.rank);\n        trailingUpdate(A_, d_, packed_.data(), liFrom, curJ0_, curNb_, curJ1_, cb, ce);\n    }\n\n  private:\n    std::vector<double>& A_;\n    const Dist& d_;\n    const size_t n_;\n    const int P_;\n    std::vector<double> blockBuf_, blockRecv_, LkkT_, packed_, sendbuf_, recvbuf_;\n    std::vector<int> counts_, displs_;\n    MPI_Request req_ = MPI_REQUEST_NULL;\n    bool pending_ = false;\n    size_t curJ0_ = 0, curNb_ = 0, curJ1_ = 0, liStart_ = 0;\n};\n\n// Distributed Cholesky on the local rows. Returns true on success (on all ranks).\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& Aloc, const Dist& d) {\n    const size_t n = d.n;\n    const size_t nblocks = (n + NB - 1) / NB;\n    PanelFactorizer pf(Aloc, d);\n\n    if (nblocks > 0 && !pf.factorAndStart(0)) return false;\n\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < nblocks; ++k) {\n        const size_t j1 = std::min(n, (k + 1) * NB);  // first column after panel k\n        if (j1 >= n) break;\n        pf.finishGather();\n\n        const size_t j2 = std::min(n, j1 + NB);  // end of block column k+1\n        // lookahead: update block column k+1 first, then factor it and start\n        // its allgather, then apply the rest of panel k's update\n        pf.update(j1, j1, j2);\n        if (!pf.factorAndStart(k + 1)) return false;\n        pf.update(j2, j2, n);\n    }\n\n    // Zero out upper triangular part of local rows\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < d.nloc; ++li) {\n        const size_t g = d.globalRow(li);\n        double* row = Aloc.data() + li * n;\n        for (size_t j = g + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            row[j] = 0.0;\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate the local rows of a symmetric positive definite matrix.\n// Identical values to the sequential generator: A = B * B^T + n * I with B from\n// rand_r(seed = 42).\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& Aloc, const Dist& d) {\n    const size_t n = d.n;\n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < d.nloc; ++li) {\n        const size_t i = d.globalRow(li);\n        const double* bi = B.data() + i * n;\n        double* arow = Aloc.data() + li * n;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double* bj = B.data() + j * n;\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += bi[k] * bj[k];\n            }\n            arow[j] = sum;\n        }\n        arow[i] += n;\n    }\n}\n\n// Gather the distributed rows into a full matrix in global row order.\n// If toAll is true every rank receives the result, otherwise only rank 0.\nvoid gatherMatrix(const std::vector<double>& Aloc, const Dist& d, std::vector<double>& A,\n                  bool toAll) {\n    const size_t n = d.n;\n    const int P = d.nprocs;\n    std::vector<int> counts(P), displs(P);\n    int disp = 0;\n    for (int r = 0; r < P; ++r) {\n        counts[r] = (int)(d.localRows(r) * n);\n        displs[r] = disp;\n        disp += counts[r];\n    }\n    std::vector<double> tmp;\n    if (toAll || d.rank == 0) {\n        tmp.resize(n * n);\n    }\n    if (toAll) {\n        MPI_Allgatherv(Aloc.data(), (int)(d.nloc * n), MPI_DOUBLE, tmp.data(), counts.data(),\n                       displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    } else {\n        MPI_Gatherv(Aloc.data(), (int)(d.nloc * n), MPI_DOUBLE, tmp.data(), counts.data(),\n                    displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    }\n    if (toAll || d.rank == 0) {\n        A.resize(n * n);\n        for (int r = 0; r < P; ++r) {\n            const size_t cnt = d.localRows(r);\n            const double* src = tmp.data() + displs[r];\n            for (size_t q = 0; q < cnt; ++q) {\n                memcpy(A.data() + d.globalRow(q, r) * n, src + q * n, n * sizeof(double));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Validate by computing L * L^T (rows distributed) and comparing with the original.\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& AorigLoc,\n                      const Dist& d) {\n    const size_t n = d.n;\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n\n    std::vector<double> recon(n);\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < d.nloc; ++li) {\n        const size_t i = d.globalRow(li);\n        const double* Li = L.data() + i * n;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double* Lj = L.data() + j * n;\n            // entries beyond min(i, j) are exactly zero in L and contribute nothing\n            const size_t kend = std::min(i, j) + 1;\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < kend; ++k) {\n                sum += Li[k] * Lj[k];\n            }\n            recon[j] = sum;\n        }\n        const double* orig = AorigLoc.data() + li * n;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double error = fabs(recon[j] - orig[j]);\n            maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n            const double rel = error / (fabs(orig[j]) + 1e-10);\n            relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n        }\n    }\n\n    double gmax[2] = {0.0, 0.0};\n    double lmax[2] = {maxError, relError};\n    MPI_Allreduce(lmax, gmax, 2, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    maxError = gmax[0];\n    relError = gmax[1];\n\n    if (d.rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n        printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n    }\n\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        if (d.rank == 0) printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\n}  // namespace\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n    int rank = 0, nprocs = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &nprocs);\n\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (rank == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n columns j + jj < end.\ninline void storeTile(double* ar, v4d acc0, v4d acc1, const size_t j, const size_t end) {\n    if (j + JW <= end) {\n        storev(ar, loadv(ar) - acc0);\n        storev(ar + jj = 0; jj < len; ++jj) {\n            ar[jj] -= tmp[jj];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// A[r][j] -= sum_c L[r][c] * P[c][j] for 4 rows and tiles [tb, te).\n// Row r only stores local columns j < end[r]. jbase is the local column of tile 0.\ninline void updateTiles4(double* const* a, const double* const* l, const size_t* end,\n                         const double* __restrict packed, const size_t nb, const size_t jbase,\n                         const size_t tb, const size_t te) {\n    const double* __restrict l0 = l[0];\n    const double* __restrict l1 = l[1];\n    const double* __restrict l2 = l[2];\n    const double* __restrict l3 = l[3];\n    for (size_t t = tb; t < te; ++t) {\n        const double* __restrict pk = packed + t * nb * JW;\n        v4d a00 = bcastv(0.0), a01 = a00, a10 = a00, a11 = a00;\n        v4d a20 = a00, a21 = a00, a30 = a00, a31 = a00;\n        for (size_t c = 0; c < nb; ++c) {\n            const v4d p0 = loadv(pk + c * JW);\n            const v4d p1 = loadv(pk + c * JW + 4);\n            v4d b;\n            b = bcastv(l0[c]); a00 += b * p0; a01 += b * p1;\n            b = bcastv(l1[c]); a10 += b * p0; a11 += b * p1;\n            b = bcastv(l2[c]); a20 += b * p0; a21 += b * p1;\n            b = bcastv(l3[c]); a30 += b * p0; a31 += b * p1;\n        }\n        const size_t j = jbase + t * JW;\n        storeTile(a[0] + j, a00, a01, j, end[0]);\n        storeTile(a[1] + j, a10, a11, j, end[1]);\n        storeTile(a[2] + j, a20, a21, j, end[2]);\n        storeTile(a[3] + j, a30, a31, j, end[3]);\n    }\n}\n\ninline void updateTiles1(double* a, const double* __restrict l0, const size_t end,\n                         const double* __restrict packed, const size_t nb, const size_t jbase,\n                         const size_t tb, const size_t te) {\n    for (size_t t = tb; t < te; ++t) {\n        const double* __restrict pk = packed + t * nb * JW;\n        v4d a00 = bcastv(0.0), a01 = a00;\n        for (size_t c = 0; c < nb; ++c) {\n            const v4d b = bcastv(l0[c]);\n            a00 += b * loadv(pk + c * JW);\n            a01 += b * loadv(pk + c * JW + 4);\n        }\n        const size_t j = jbase + t * JW;\n        storeTile(a + j, a00, a01, j, end);\n    }\n}\n\n// Pipelined panel factorization with one panel of lookahead.\nclass PanelFactorizer {\n  public:\n    PanelFactorizer(std::vector<double>& Aloc, const Layout& L) : A_(Aloc), L_(L), n_(L.n) {\n        blockBuf_.resize(NB * NB);\n        blockRecv_.resize(NB * NB);\n        LkkT_.resize(NB * NB);\n        for (auto& b : Lrows_) b.resize(L.nloc * NB + 1);\n        colSend_.resize(L.nloc * NB);\n        colRecv_.resize(L.ncloc * NB);\n        packed_.resize((L.ncloc + JW) * NB);\n        blkCounts_.resize(L.Pr);\n        blkDispls_.resize(L.Pr);\n        counts_.resize(L.Pr);\n        displs_.resize(L.Pr);\n    }\n\n    // Factor the diagonal block of panel k, solve the rows below it (on the\n    // owning process column) and start the panel communication.\n    // Returns false if the matrix was found not to be positive definite; ranks\n    // outside the owning process column learn that later from finishPanel().\n    bool startPanel(const size_t k) {\n        Panel& p = cur_;\n        p.k = k;\n        p.j0 = k * NB;\n        p.nb = std::min(NB, n_ - p.j0);\n        p.j1 = p.j0 + p.nb;\n        p.liStart = L_.rowsBefore(p.j1);\n        p.buf = (int)(k % 2);\n        const size_t nBelow = L_.nloc - p.liStart;\n        const int root = L_.colOwner(p.j0);\n        std::vector<double>& lrows = Lrows_[p.buf];\n        lrows[nBelow * p.nb] = -1.0;  // status element: < 0 means success\n        bool ok = true;\n\n        if (L_.pc == root) {\n            const size_t lc0 = L_.colsBefore(p.j0);\n            const long status = factorDiagonal(p.j0, p.nb, lc0);\n            if (status >= 0) {\n                if (L_.pr == 0) {  // printed once, by the first rank of the owning column\n                    printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\",\n                           (size_t)(p.j0 + status));\n                }\n                lrows[nBelow * p.nb] = (double)(p.j0 + status);\n                ok = false;\n            } else if (p.j1 < n_) {\n                // TRSM of local rows below the diagonal block, then pack them\n                size_t li = p.liStart;\n                for (; li + 4 <= L_.nloc; li += 4) {\n                    double* rows[4];\n                    for (int r = 0; r < 4; ++r) rows[r] = A_.data() + (li + r) * L_.ncloc + lc0;\n                    trsmRows<4>(rows, LkkT_.data(), p.nb);\n                }\n                for (; li < L_.nloc; ++li) {\n                    double* rows[1] = {A_.data() + li * L_.ncloc + lc0};\n                    trsmRows<1>(rows, LkkT_.data(), p.nb);\n                }\n                for (size_t r = 0; r < nBelow; ++r) {\n                    memcpy(lrows.data() + r * p.nb, A_.data() + (p.liStart + r) * L_.ncloc + lc0,\n                           p.nb * sizeof(double));\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // broadcast the panel rows (+ status) along the process row\n        MPI_Ibcast(lrows.data(), (int)(nBelow * p.nb + 1), MPI_DOUBLE, root, L_.rowComm,\n                   &bcastReq_);\n        p.state = Panel::BCAST;\n        if (!ok) {\n            MPI_Wait(&bcastReq_, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n            p.state = Panel::FAILED;\n        }\n        return ok;\n    }\n\n    // Let the pending communication of the started panel make progress.\n    void poll() {\n        Panel& p = cur_;\n        if (p.state == Panel::BCAST) {\n            int flag = 0;\n            MPI_Test(&bcastReq_, &flag, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n            if (flag) onBcastDone();\n        } else if (p.state == Panel::GATHER) {\n            int flag = 0;\n            MPI_Test(&gatherReq_, &flag, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n            if (flag) p.state = Panel::DONE;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Wait for the started panel, unpack it and make it the panel to apply.\n    // Returns false if the factorization failed.\n    bool finishPanel() {\n        Panel& p = cur_;\n        if (p.state == Panel::BCAST) {\n            MPI_Wait(&bcastReq_, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n            onBcastDone();\n        }\n        if (p.state == Panel::GATHER) {\n            MPI_Wait(&gatherReq_, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n            p.state = Panel::DONE;\n        }\n        if (p.state == Panel::FAILED) return false;\n        if (p.j1 < n_) unpackPanel();\n        upd_ = p;\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    // Apply the update of the last finished panel to local columns [cb, ce)\n    // of local rows >= rowFrom (global), polling the pending communication.\n    void update(const size_t rowFrom, const size_t cb, const size_t ce) {\n        const Panel& p = upd_;\n        const size_t liFrom = L_.rowsBefore(rowFrom);\n        if (cb >= ce || liFrom >= L_.nloc) return;\n        const size_t ncloc = L_.ncloc;\n        const size_t jbase = L_.colsBefore(p.j1);  // local column of tile 0\n        const double* lrows = Lrows_[p.buf].data();\n        const double* packed = packed_.data();\n        const size_t tBegin = (cb - jbase) / JW;\n        const size_t tEnd = (ce - jbase + JW - 1) / JW;\n        for (size_t tc = tBegin; tc < tEnd; tc += JC) {\n            const size_t tcEnd = std::min(tEnd, tc + JC);\n            size_t li = liFrom;\n            // Row groups of 4 never straddle a row block (DB % 4 == 0 and liFrom\n            // is a block boundary); only the last partial block has a remainder.\n            for (; li + 4 <= L_.nloc; li += 4) {\n                double* a[4];\n                const double* l[4];\n                size_t end[4];\n                for (int r = 0; r < 4; ++r) {\n                    a[r] = A_.data() + (li + r) * ncloc;\n                    l[r] = lrows + (li + r - p.liStart) * p.nb;\n                    end[r] = L_.colsBefore(L_.globalRow(li + r) + 1);\n                }\n                const size_t te =\n                    end[3] > jbase ? std::min(tcEnd, (end[3] - jbase + JW - 1) / JW) : 0;\n                if (tc < te) {\n                    updateTiles4(a, l, end, packed, p.nb, jbase, tc, te);\n                    poll();\n                }\n            }\n            for (; li < L_.nloc; ++li) {\n                double* a = A_.data() + li * ncloc;\n                const double* l = lrows + (li - p.liStart) * p.nb;\n                const size_t end = L_.colsBefore(L_.globalRow(li) + 1);\n                const size_t te = end > jbase ? std::min(tcEnd, (end - jbase + JW - 1) / JW) : 0;\n                if (tc < te) updateTiles1(a, l, end, packed, p.nb, jbase, tc, te);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n  private:\n    struct Panel {\n        enum State { NONE, BCAST, GATHER, DONE, FAILED };\n        size_t k = 0, j0 = 0, nb = 0, j1 = 0, liStart = 0;\n        int buf = 0;\n        State state = NONE;\n    };\n\n    // Allgather the diagonal block within the process column, factor it and\n    // write the owned rows back. Returns the failing index or -1.\n    long factorDiagonal(const size_t j0, const size_t nb, const size_t lc0) {\n        const size_t j1 = j0 + nb;\n        const size_t myFirst = L_.rowsBefore(j0);\n        const size_t myCnt = L_.rowsBefore(j1) - myFirst;\n        for (size_t q = 0; q < myCnt; ++q) {\n            memcpy(blockBuf_.data() + q * nb, A_.data() + (myFirst + q) * L_.ncloc + lc0,\n                   nb * sizeof(double));\n        }\n        int disp = 0;\n        for (int r = 0; r < L_.Pr; ++r) {\n            const size_t cnt = L_.rowsBefore(j1, r) - L_.rowsBefore(j0, r);\n            blkCounts_[r] = (int)(cnt * nb);\n            blkDispls_[r] = disp;\n            disp += blkCounts_[r];\n        }\n        MPI_Allgatherv(blockBuf_.data(), (int)(myCnt * nb), MPI_DOUBLE, blockRecv_.data(),\n                       blkCounts_.data(), blkDispls_.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, L_.colComm);\n        for (int r = 0; r < L_.Pr; ++r) {\n            const size_t first = L_.rowsBefore(j0, r);\n            const size_t cnt = (size_t)blkCounts_[r] / nb;\n            for (size_t q = 0; q < cnt; ++q) {\n                const size_t i = L_.globalRow(first + q, r) - j0;\n                memcpy(blockBuf_.data() + i * nb, blockRecv_.data() + blkDispls_[r] + q * nb,\n                       nb * sizeof(double));\n            }\n        }\n\n        const long status = factorDiagonalBlock(blockBuf_.data(), nb);\n        if (status >= 0) return status;\n\n        for (size_t q = 0; q < myCnt; ++q) {\n            const size_t i = L_.globalRow(myFirst + q) - j0;\n            memcpy(A_.data() + (myFirst + q) * L_.ncloc + lc0, blockBuf_.data() + i * nb,\n                   nb * sizeof(double));\n        }\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < nb; ++i) {\n            for (size_t c = 0; c < nb; ++c) {\n                LkkT_[c * nb + i] = (c <= i) ? blockBuf_[i * nb + c] : 0.0;\n            }\n        }\n        return -1;\n    }\n\n    // Number of rows >= j1 of process row r that lie in my column blocks.\n    size_t contribRows(const size_t j1, const int r) const {\n        size_t cnt = 0;\n        const size_t nrows = L_.localRows(r);\n        for (size_t li = L_.rowsBefore(j1, r); li < nrows; li += DB) {\n            const size_t g = L_.globalRow(li, r);\n            if (L_.colOwner(g) == L_.pc) cnt += std::min(DB, nrows - li);\n        }\n        return cnt;\n    }\n\n    // The row broadcast completed: check the status and start the column\n    // allgather of the panel rows belonging to my columns.\n    void onBcastDone() {\n        Panel& p = cur_;\n        const size_t nBelow = L_.nloc - p.liStart;\n        if (Lrows_[p.buf][nBelow * p.nb] >= 0.0) {\n            p.state = Panel::FAILED;\n            return;\n        }\n        if (p.j1 >= n_) {\n            p.state = Panel::DONE;\n            return;\n        }\n        // pack my rows that are columns of mine\n        const double* lrows = Lrows_[p.buf].data();\n        size_t cnt = 0;\n        for (size_t li = p.liStart; li < L_.nloc; li += DB) {\n            const size_t g = L_.globalRow(li);\n            if (L_.colOwner(g) != L_.pc) continue;\n            const size_t rows = std::min(DB, L_.nloc - li);\n            memcpy(colSend_.data() + cnt * p.nb, lrows + (li - p.liStart) * p.nb,\n                   rows * p.nb * sizeof(double));\n            cnt += rows;\n        }\n        int disp = 0;\n        for (int r = 0; r < L_.Pr; ++r) {\n            counts_[r] = (int)(contribRows(p.j1, r) * p.nb);\n            displs_[r] = disp;\n            disp += counts_[r];\n        }\n        MPI_Iallgatherv(colSend_.data(), (int)(cnt * p.nb), MPI_DOUBLE, colRecv_.data(),\n                        counts_.data(), displs_.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, L_.colComm, &gatherReq_);\n        p.state = Panel::GATHER;\n    }\n\n    // Unpack the collected panel rows into the tile-packed layout (by local column).\n    void unpackPanel() {\n        const Panel& p = cur_;\n        const size_t nb = p.nb;\n        const size_t jbase = L_.colsBefore(p.j1);\n        for (int r = 0; r < L_.Pr; ++r) {\n            const double* src = colRecv_.data() + displs_[r];\n            const size_t nrows = L_.localRows(r);\n            size_t q = 0;\n            for (size_t li = L_.rowsBefore(p.j1, r); li < nrows; li += DB) {\n                const size_t g = L_.globalRow(li, r);\n                if (L_.colOwner(g) != L_.pc) continue;\n                const size_t rows = std::min(DB, nrows - li);\n                const size_t lj = L_.colsBefore(g) - jbase;  // local column of row g\n                const double* s = src + q * nb;\n                double* dst = packed_.data() + (lj / JW) * nb * JW + (lj % JW);\n                if (rows == JW) {\n                    // DB == JW aligned run: transpose JW rows into one tile\n                    for (size_t c = 0; c < nb; ++c) {\n                        for (size_t jj = 0; jj < JW; ++jj) {\n                            dst[c * JW + jj] = s[jj * nb + c];\n                        }\n                    }\n                } else {\n                    for (size_t x = 0; x < rows; ++x) {\n                        for (size_t c = 0; c < nb; ++c) {\n                            dst[c * JW + x] = s[x * nb + c];\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n                q += rows;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    std::vector<double>& A_;\n    const Layout& L_;\n    const size_t n_;\n    std::vector<double> blockBuf_, blockRecv_, LkkT_;\n    std::vector<double> Lrows_[2];  // broadcast panel rows (double buffered)\n    std::vector<double> colSend_, colRecv_, packed_;\n    std::vector<int> blkCounts_, blkDispls_, counts_, displs_;\n    MPI_Request bcastReq_ = MPI_REQUEST_NULL, gatherReq_ = MPI_REQUEST_NULL;\n    Panel cur_;  // panel whose communication is in flight\n    Panel upd_;  // panel being applied\n};\n\n// Distributed Cholesky on the local block. Returns true on success (on all ranks).\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& Aloc, const Layout& L) {\n    const size_t n = L.n;\n    const size_t nblocks = (n + NB - 1) / NB;\n    PanelFactorizer pf(Aloc, L);\n\n    bool ok = true;\n    if (nblocks > 0 && !pf.startPanel(0)) ok = false;\n\n    for (size_t k = 0; ok && k < nblocks; ++k) {\n        if (!pf.finishPanel()) {\n            ok = false;\n            break;\n        }\n        const size_t j1 = std::min(n, (k + 1) * NB);  // first column after panel k\n        if (j1 >= n) break;\n        const size_t j2 = std::min(n, j1 + NB);  // end of block column k+1\n        const size_t lc1 = L.colsBefore(j1), lc2 = L.colsBefore(j2);\n\n        // lookahead: update block column k+1 first, then factor it and start\n        // its communication, then apply the rest of panel k's update\n        pf.update(j1, lc1, lc2);\n        if (!pf.startPanel(k + 1)) {\n            ok = false;\n            break;\n        }\n        pf.update(j2, lc2, L.ncloc);\n    }\n    if (!ok) return false;\n\n    // Zero out upper triangular part of the local block\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < L.nloc; ++li) {\n        const size_t g = L.globalRow(li);\n        double* row = Aloc.data() + li * L.ncloc;\n        for (size_t lj = L.colsBefore(g + 1); lj < L.ncloc; ++lj) {\n            row[lj] = 0.0;\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate the local block of a symmetric positive definite matrix.\n// Identical values to the sequential generator: A = B * B^T + n * I with B from\n// rand_r(seed = 42).\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& Aloc, const Layout& L) {\n    const size_t n = L.n;\n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < L.nloc; ++li) {\n        const size_t i = L.globalRow(li);\n        const double* bi = B.data() + i * n;\n        double* arow = Aloc.data() + li * L.ncloc;\n        for (size_t lj = 0; lj < L.ncloc; ++lj) {\n            const size_t j = L.globalCol(lj);\n            const double* bj = B.data() + j * n;\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += bi[k] * bj[k];\n            }\n            arow[lj] = sum;\n            if (i == j) arow[lj] += n;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Gather the distributed blocks into a full matrix in global order.\n// If toAll is true every rank receives the result, otherwise only rank 0.\nvoid gatherMatrix(const std::vector<double>& Aloc, const Layout& L, std::vector<double>& A,\n                  bool toAll) {\n    const size_t n = L.n;\n    std::vector<int> counts(L.P), displs(L.P);\n    int disp = 0;\n    for (int r = 0; r < L.P; ++r) {\n        counts[r] =\n            (int)(L.localRows(Layout::rowOf(r, L.Pc)) * L.localCols(Layout::colOf(r, L.Pc)));\n        displs[r] = disp;\n        disp += counts[r];\n    }\n    std::vector<double> tmp;\n    if (toAll || L.rank == 0) {\n        tmp.resize(n * n);\n    }\n    if (toAll) {\n        MPI_Allgatherv(Aloc.data(), (int)Aloc.size(), MPI_DOUBLE, tmp.data(), counts.data(),\n                       displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    } else {\n        MPI_Gatherv(Aloc.data(), (int)Aloc.size(), MPI_DOUBLE, tmp.data(), counts.data(),\n                    displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    }\n    if (toAll || L.rank == 0) {\n        A.resize(n * n);\n        for (int r = 0; r < L.P; ++r) {\n            const int pr = Layout::rowOf(r, L.Pc), pc = Layout::colOf(r, L.Pc);\n            const size_t nr = L.localRows(pr), nc = L.localCols(pc);\n            const double* src = tmp.data() + displs[r];\n            for (size_t li = 0; li < nr; ++li) {\n                const size_t gi = L.globalRow(li, pr);\n                for (size_t lj = 0; lj < nc; lj += NB) {\n                    const size_t gj = L.globalCol(lj, pc);\n                    const size_t w = std::min(NB, nc - lj);\n                    memcpy(A.data() + gi * n + gj, src + li * nc + lj, w * sizeof(double));\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Validate by computing L * L^T (distributed) and comparing with the original.\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& Lfull, const std::vector<double>& AorigLoc,\n                      const Layout& L) {\n    const size_t n = L.n;\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < L.nloc; ++li) {\n        const size_t i = L.globalRow(li);\n        const double* Li = Lfull.data() + i * n;\n        const double* orig = AorigLoc.data() + li * L.ncloc;\n        for (size_t lj = 0; lj < L.ncloc; ++lj) {\n            const size_t j = L.globalCol(lj);\n            const double* Lj = Lfull.data() + j * n;\n            // entries beyond min(i, j) are exactly zero in L and contribute nothing\n            const size_t kend = std::min(i, j) + 1;\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < kend; ++k) {\n                sum += Li[k] * Lj[k];\n            }\n            const double error = fabs(sum - orig[lj]);\n            maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n            const double rel = error / (fabs(orig[lj]) + 1e-10);\n            relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n        }\n    }\n\n    double gmax[2] = {0.0, 0.0};\n    double lmax[2] = {maxError, relError};\n    MPI_Allreduce(lmax, gmax, 2, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    maxError = gmax[0];\n    relError = gmax[1];\n\n    if (L.rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n        printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n    }\n\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        if (L.rank == 0) printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\n}  // namespace\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n    int rank = 0, nprocs = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &nprocs);\n\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (rank == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    Layout L;\n    L.init(n, rank, nprocs);\n\n    if \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// MPI-parallel Cholesky decomposition.\n// Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular.\n//\n// Data distribution: 1D block-cyclic by rows with small blocks of DB rows dealt\n// round-robin to the ranks (fine granularity keeps the triangular workload\n// balanced). Every rank stores its rows as full-length (n-wide) contiguous rows\n// in local memory, in increasing global row order.\n//\n// Algorithm: right-looking blocked Cholesky with panel width NB and one panel\n// of lookahead. For every panel (block column) k:\n//   1. the NB x NB diagonal block is allgathered from its row owners and\n//      factored redundantly on every rank (cheap, and it replaces a broadcast),\n//   2. every rank solves its rows below the block: L_ik = A_ik * L_kk^-T,\n//   3. the panel L_{i>k,k} is allgathered with a nonblocking collective,\n//   4. every rank applies the rank-NB update A_ij -= L_ik * L_jk^T to its rows.\n// Lookahead: once panel k has arrived, the update is first applied to block\n// column k+1 only, panel k+1 is factored and its allgather is started, and the\n// remaining update of panel k overlaps with that communication.\n//\n// The floating-point operation order is independent of the number of ranks, so\n// the result is bitwise identical for any process count.\n\nnamespace {\n\nconstexpr size_t NB = 48; k < j; ++k) {\n                sum += ri[k] * rj[k];\n            }\n            ri[j] = (ri[j] - sum) / rj[j];\n        }\n        double sum = 0.0;\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < i; ++k) {\n            sum += ri[k] * ri[k];\n        }\n        const double val = ri[i] - sum;\n        if (val <= 0.0) {\n            return (long)i;\n        }\n        ri[i] = sqrt(val);\n    }\n    return -1;\n}\n\n// Triangular solve of R rows at once: row[r][c] for c < nb becomes L_i,(j0+c).\n// LkkT is the transposed diagonal block (LkkT[d * nb + c] = L_kk[c][d]).\ntemplate <int R>\ninline void trsmRows(double* const* rows, const double* __restrict LkkT, const size_t nb) {\n    for (size_t d = 0; c < nb; ++c) {\n                x[c] -= xd * ld[c];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// --- Trailing update micro-kernel -------------------------------------------\n// The gathered panel is stored tile-packed: columns are grouped into tiles of\n// JW consecutive columns, and within a tile the nb panel entries of the JW\n// columns are interleaved: packed[(tile * nb + c) * JW + jj].\n\ntypedef double v4d __attribute__((vector_size(32)));\n\ninline v4d loadv(const double* p) {\n    v4d v;\n    memcpy(&v, p, sizeof(v));\n    return v;\n}\ninline void storev(double* p, v4d v) { memcpy(p, &v, sizeof(v)); q < myCnt; ++q) {\n                const size_t i = d_.globalRow(myFirst + q) - j0;\n                memcpy(A_.data() + (myFirst + q) * n_ + j0, blockBuf_.data() + i * nb,\n                       nb * sizeof(double));\n            }\n            for (size_t i = 0; Only `cholesky/cholesky.cpp` and `cholesky/CMakeLists.txt` changed, the executable is still `cholesky`, and no new files or dependencies were added beyond MPI itself.\n\n**Design**\n\n- **2D block-cyclic distribution** over a near-square Pr x Pc process grid (8 x 8 for 64 ranks, 3 x 1 for prime counts). Rows are dealt in 8-row blocks, columns in 48-column blocks, so the triangular workload stays balanced.\n- **Right-looking blocked algorithm with one panel of lookahead.** The 48 x 48 diagonal block is allgathered within its process column and factored redundantly, which replaces a broadcast. The triangular solve runs on the owning column, the panel rows go out with a nonblocking row broadcast, and each rank collects only the panel rows for columns it owns with a nonblocking column allgather. The update of block column k+1 runs first so panel k+1 can start while the rest of panel k's update overlaps the communication, with `MPI_Test` polling from the compute loop to drive progress.\n- **Vectorized kernels.** The trailing update is a 4-row by 8-column register-tiled AVX2 micro-kernel on a tile-packed panel with L2 column chunking. The loaded panel vectors are pinned to registers with an empty asm barrier, which doubled kernel throughput because GCC otherwise folds them into every FMA as memory operands.\n- **Generation and validation are distributed too**, with the matrix generated identically to the original. Only rank 0 prints. The result is gathered to rank 0 for `-r` and to all ranks for `-v`.\n\n**Correctness**\n\n- Validation passes on every process count tested (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 16, 64, 128) with max relative error about 1e-12.\n- The per-element operation order does not depend on the process count, so the result hash is bitwise identical for every grid shape.\n- Sizes 0, 1, 2, 5, 7, 8, 47, 48, 49, 95, 97, 100, 200, 333 all match the original program's printed sums and samples. Two of them differ in the 16th significant digit, which is the expected rounding change from blocked summation; the result hash therefore differs from the sequential program, as it would for any blocked implementation.\n- The non-positive-definite path was tested by injecting a bad diagonal at rows 0, 100 and 511: every rank exits with code 1 after rank 0 prints the original error message, with no hang.\n\n**Performance** (this host, 2 x 64-core EPYC 7763, `--bind-to core`)\n\n| n | original | 1 rank | 16 ranks | 64 ranks | 128 ranks |\n|---|---|---|---|---|---|\n| 2048 | 2146 ms | | 33 ms | | |\n| 4096 | ~17 s (extrapolated) | 1064 ms | 130 ms | 57 ms | |\n| 8192 | | | | 224 ms | 162 ms (1.13 TFLOPS) |\n\nOne rank is about 15x faster than the original from the blocked, vectorized kernel alone. Scaling on this single node is limited by the fact that shared-memory communication is CPU copy work; on a real cluster with network offload the overlap would hide more of it.\n\n**Notes for building and running**\n\n```\ncmake -S cholesky -B build && cmake --build build\nmpirun -np 64 ./build/cholesky -n 4096 -v -r\n```\n\nThe panel width (`NB = 48`) and row block (`DB = 8`) are compile-time constants at the top of the source.
